scope: Full current repeated forward and reverse cycle tests
assessment: Forward move after activated return retains exact predecessor binding evidence and resolves both prior locations to active binding
Repeated switches and object-only shared-workspace changes preserve original artifact and later runs
Receipt or configuration synchronization interruptions resume; rollback restores exact previous storage controls
Four activated reverse cycles preserve all accumulated runs in separate and shared workspaces
Altered predecessor, replaced activation or foreign project fence refuses recovery/planning while preserving configuration and fence
limitations: Current-format predecessor history only; no legacy compatibility or backfill
Disposable single-filesystem fixtures; no real products or cross-volume matrix
Injected interruptions rather than actual process termination; process-death evidence separate
